report: МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормалнен интензитет на сигнала. Визуализират се малки остеофитни наслагвания по латералния кондил на фемура и тибията. Ставният хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. Вижда се малък дефект в средната трета на хрущяла на пателата както при начална хондропатия. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се вижда хиперинтензна лезия с неправилен ход, достигаща до артикулиращия хрущял на фемура - grade 3. В задния рог на латерален менискус също е налице увреда в по-малка степен – grade 2a. Нормално изобразяване на предните рога на двата мениска. Изобразява се Бекерова киста на нивото на медиалната глава на мускулус гастрокнемиус с размери 36/15мм, без белези за руптуриране. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Заключение:  МР данни за увреда на задните рога на двата менискуса. Начална хондропатия на пателата. Бекерова киста. Малък ставен излив.

In the medial compartment, the medial meniscus is not torn. The articular cartilage appears normal.  
  
 The lateral compartment, there is complex tear (main horizontal component) at the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is focal cartilage fibrillation (low grade chondrosis) at the posterolateral tibial plateau.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade chondrosis along the medial and lateral patellar facets. There is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial and lateral trochleas. A intact2 cm subchondral bone cyst is identified.  The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact. 
   
 In the intercondylar notch, there is chronic partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. There is either interstitial tear or mucoid degeneration of the posterior cruciate ligament. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 There is chronic partial tear of the medial collateral ligament. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. Severe tendinopathy of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Patellofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of left knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes. 
  Focal cartilage fibrillation (low grade chondrosis) at the posterolateral tibial plateau.  
  Complex tear (main horizontal component) at the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.  
   Chronic partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
  Either interstitial tear or mucoid degeneration of the posterior cruciate ligament.  
  Chronic partial tear of the medial collateral ligament 
  Severe tendinopathy of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon: concerning for crystal deposition such as gout. 
  Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis.

Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Tibyal plato posterolateralindeki subkondral kırığı kemik iliği ödemi çevreliyor. Ön çapraz bağ tam kat yırtık olup tibya anteriyora 26 mm translasyon gösteriyor. Arka çapraz bağın femoral insersiyon kesimindeki yapı içi sinyal artışı ve milimetrik sıvı intensitesi bu kesimdeki parsiyel yırtığı telkin ediyor. İç yan bağ korunmuş Dış yan bağ parsiyel yırtık . Biseps femoris tendonu korunmuş. Popliteus tendonozisi izleniyor. Lateral menisküsün gövdesi ve ön boynuzunda üst eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen horizontal oblik yırtık ve serbest kenarında püsküllenme izleniyor. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzunda ait eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen horizontal oblik yırtık mevcut. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibiofibuler eklem dejenere. Gastrokinemiyus medyal ve lateral başının femoral origoları çevresinde eklem  kapsülü komşuluğunda büyüğü 9 mm boyutunda gangliyon kistleri izleniyor.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT W WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain; severe knee pain and decreased range of motion; history of negative cultures; symptoms for one week with difficulty walking and bearing weight
Comparison: Radiograph of the right knee dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 3.0 system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), without and with intravenous contrast.

Contrast: 4 mL of Gadavist

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Multiple areas of curvilinear serpiginous high T2 and low T1 signal intensity are noted in the distal femoral metadiaphysis as well as in the medial femoral condyle and proximal medial tibia with central areas of fat, characteristic for osteonecrosis. The largest in the femur measures up to 4.8 cm mediolateral by 2.5 cm anterior posterior by 7.1 cm craniocaudal dimension, with a thick peripheral rim of enhancement and central areas of fat signal intensity. These findings are age-indeterminate with a probable chronic component given the central fat and absence of surrounding geographic marrow edema. Very subtle periarticular edema is noted along the anteromedial aspect anterolateral aspect of the femoral condyles. There is mild nonspecific marrow edema and a patella. Mild marrow edema is noted at the anterior patella and deep to the popliteus tendon. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Minimal joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild grade 1/2 chondrosis of the lateral patellar facet and medial patellar facet. Thickened plica at the medial margin of the patellofemoral joint.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild tendinopathy with a low-grade intrasubstance delaminating tear centrally.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Minimal lateral patellar tilt. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. No significant joint effusion or erosive changes to suggest septic arthritis or inflammatory arthropathy. 

2. Multiple moderate to large areas of signal abnormality in the distal femur and proximal tibia demonstrating characteristic serpiginous high T2 and low T1 signal intensity, characteristic for areas of osteonecrosis. There is likely chronic component given the areas of central fat, without surrounding geographic marrow edema.

3. Mild nonspecific marrow edema in the anterior patella. Subtle periarticular marrow edema along the anteromedial and anterolateral aspects of the femoral condyles. Mild marrow edema and enhancement deep to the popliteus tendon. These findings may represent stress-related changes or early developing areas of osteonecrosis.

4. Mild patellofemoral osteoarthritis.

Trouvailles :

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.

Il y a léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage incluant les trois compartiments plus proéminent au niveau du compartiment interne avec changement réactif sous-chondral. Il n’y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet.

Il y a changements dégénératifs intrasubstance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure longitudinale d’orientation oblique au niveau de la corne postérieure. La déchirure s’étend à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il n’y a pas de fragment déplacé ou de kyste para-méniscal. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité.

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Légers changements dégénératifs impliquant les trois compartiments sans région de perte de cartilage complet.

2. Changements dégénératifs intrasubstances du ménisque interne associés à une déchirure oblique de la corne postérieure.

3. Épanchement intra-articulaire avec petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Knee pain. Exam consistent with? Meniscal injury 3. Ultrasound shows? Lateral meniscal tear. Please note this scan was ordered for the left knee but the patient insisted that the right knee was symptomatic and at the patient's insistence the right knee was scanned, not the left.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact.

There is increased T2 signal and mild thickening of the proximal fibers of the patellar tendon consistent with mild patellar tendinosis.

The patellofemoral ligaments are intact.

Articular cartilage of the patella demonstrates chondral fraying and signal change to the lateral facet with some fissuring and very faint subcortical edema seen within the bone of the lateral facet of patella. There is associated trochlear cartilage fraying and fissuring seen involving the trochlear apex and medial facet. Findings are consistent with severe chondrosis of the patellofemoral joint.

The TT-TG distance measures about 9 mm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus appears intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained.

The medial meniscus is intact. There is some linear nonsurfacing signal seen in the posterior horn extending into the posterior body of medial meniscus but a definite surfacing meniscal tear is not identified.

There is moderate chondrosis of the medial joint compartment with some regions of focal fraying and thinning and one focus of mild subcortical edema seen to the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex appear intact.

There is a small to moderate sized Baker's cyst present.

There is no evidence of a significant knee effusion.

Marrow signal is otherwise normal. 

INTERPRETATION: 

Mild patellar tendinosis.

Severe chondrosis involving patellofemoral joint.

Moderate medial compartment chondrosis.

Baker's cyst.

No evidence of internal derangement or lateral meniscal tear.

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Rotura marginal del cuerpo del menisco lateral con leve extrusión meniscal.
El menisco medial es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.

fenómenos condrales reparativos parciales. Úlceras condrales de espesor total del platillo tibial
lateral en su región central sin cambios óseos secundarios significativos.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial medial sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de distribución difusa de la articulación patelofemoral
con cambios óseos secundarios.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Moderado quiste poplíteo con fenómenos de filtración
hacia caudal.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Off-and-on knee pain for a few years. [REDACTED]. Patellar tendon.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage fissure along the lateral patellar facet with subchondral edema/cystic changes. Trochlear cartilage is preserved.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: Moderate proximal patellar tendinosis with low-grade partial-thickness interstitial tearing of the central fibers involving approximately 25% of the cross section of fibers.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 18 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Moderate proximal patellar tendinosis with low-grade partial-thickness interstitial tearing of the central fibers.
2.	Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.
3.	Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, as described above.
